endcard: Save this for the day you feel too far

save.ar:
لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
save.tr: “…do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.”

lines.say: Think your sins are too many for Allah to forgive? Listen to this.
Allah says: Say, O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
lines.cap: “…do not despair of the mercy of Allāh.”

lines.say: Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
The very next verse shows the way: And return in repentance to your Lord, and submit to Him.
Ibn Kathir explains: whoever repents and turns back, Allah forgives him, even if his sins are like the foam of the sea.
lines.cap: Even if the sins are like the foam of the sea

lines.say: The door of repentance is wide open. Walk back to Him today.
Save this, and send it to someone who thinks it's too late.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone who thinks it's too late 🤍
